Name: Jacs the dog
Author: katochalol
Description:
[u]Content:[/u]
A simple mod that replaces the sprite sheet of the pointed-eared dog (dog1 in the files) with a pixel art version of Jacs that I made. You, too, can have a cute fluffy boy wandering around your farm. I decided to make this mod after he passed away a few months ago and I decided that since I couldn't  have him in real life anymore, I'd put him in games.


[u]Requirements:[/u]
Content Patcher
SMAPI


[u]Installation:[/u]
It's a regular ZIP file, so simply extract it into your ".../Stardew Valley/Mods" folder.﻿


[u]Compatibility:[/u]
Works with anything that doesn't edit dog1 in the files.


[u]Activating Mid-Game:[/u]
It's best to just use this on a new save file, but if you don't want to start over, there is [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/413150/discussions/0/4048138220343576857/]something you can do[/url]. Using Ctrl + F in Notepad or any other text editor will allow you to quickly search through the document. Just be careful NOT to click "Find and Replace". If you do, just undo it or exit and re-open the file.
[list=1]
[*]Back up your game save, you'll be editing your save file and you don't want to have to worry about messing up the only copy. With Steam, your save is going to be in your AppData folder. You can use [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Saves#Find_your_save_files]this[/url]﻿ to find out how to get there.
[*]Open the save files in a text editor (like Notepad, Notepad++, Atom, whatever).
[*]The first thing you'll need to change for switching from cat TO dog: <[i]cat[/i]Person>true</[i]cat[/i]Person> TO <[i]dog[/i]Person>true</[i]dog[/i]Person>
[*]then you need to find <NPC xsi:type="Cat"> TO <NPC xsi:type="Dog">. (Right below this is where you can edit the pet's name.)
[*]Lastly, you can change the breed by finding <whichBreed>0</whichBreed> and changing the value to 1 for Jacs.
[*]Save, then you should be done.
[/list]
